## Audit Stage (Layer 3 final check + Layer 5)

**Purpose:** Independently re-verify every citeP in every generated insight before the report is allowed to build.

**TODO:**
1. Execute Command node: `python3 python/sidecar/auditor.py --project-id {{project_id}} --dsn $POSTGRES_DSN`.
2. IF node: `passed == true` -> continue to Report stage; else -> Wait node (human review) with the list of unmatched citations.

This stage runs in Python deliberately — it is the final, independent gate and must not share failure modes with the n8n Code-node validators upstream.
